subject: Your Long Boil workshop is out of steam
lines: {tinker}, in The Long Boil, the game you joined, your Boiler is out of steam and your workshop is idle. This is only a reminder.
Your workshop, in a city that rides on steam, can run for a stretch without you, then wait. Anything it made is waiting there.
The Boiler fills when you come back, whenever that is.
opt_out: You got this because you signed up for The Long Boil, where reminders are on by default. The link below turns them off in one click, no sign-in needed.
